description: This file contains integration tests for the Savings Interest Posting Job in the Apache Fineract project. It tests various scenarios including interest posting, overdraft interest, duplication checks, account balance after interest posting, and interactions with global configurations related to interest posting jobs.

classes.name: SavingsInterestPostingJobIntegrationTest
classes.description: This class contains multiple integration test cases for verifying the behavior of savings interest posting jobs, including interest calculation, posting accuracy, handling overdrafts, duplicate interest postings, and interactions with global configurations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including setting up REST-assured specifications and helper objects.

methods.name: testSavingsBalanceCheckAfterDailyInterestPostingJob
methods.description: Tests the correctness of savings balance after the daily interest posting job runs.

methods.name: testSavingsDailyInterestPostingJobWithAccountingNone
methods.description: Verifies that no journal entries are created when the savings account's accounting rule is set to 'None' during interest posting.

methods.name: testDuplicateOverdraftInterestPostingJob
methods.description: Ensures that duplicate interest postings for overdraft accounts are not created.

methods.name: testSavingsDailyInterestPostingJob
methods.description: Checks the correct interest amount, date, and submission date on the interest posting transaction.

methods.name: testSavingsDailyOverdraftInterestPostingJob
methods.description: Verifies interest posting on overdraft savings accounts, especially negative interest behavior.

methods.name: testAccountBalanceWithWithdrawalFeeAfterInterestPostingJob
methods.description: Verifies that account balances reflect withdrawal fees and interest calculations appropriately after interest posting.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountDailyPosting
methods.description: Helper method to create and activate a savings account with daily posting interest configuration.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountDailyPostingWithAccounting
methods.description: Creates and activates a savings account with daily interest posting in an 'None' accounting scenario.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountDailyPostingWithCharge
methods.description: Creates and activates a savings account with charges applied.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountDailyPostingOverdraft
methods.description: Creates and activates an overdraft savings account with daily interest posting.

methods.name: createSavingsProductDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates a savings product with daily interest compounding and posting period types.

methods.name: createSavingsProductDailyPostingOverdraft
methods.description: Creates a savings product with overdraft feature and daily interest configurations.

methods.name: createSavingsProduct
methods.description: Creates a savings product with 'None' accounting rule for testing purposes.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets global configurations to default after each test.
